summary: Four candidate documents directly apply contrastive learning (representation learning with paired positive and negative examples) to crop/agricultural yield estimation. [V0048] (Brennan et al., 2018) evaluates on ToxiBench and reports F1=0.83. [V0045] (Gupta et al., 2024) uses the AgriSat-4 dataset and reports accuracy=0.62. [V0046] (Haddad et al., 2025) applies the method to LedgerGuard and reports MAE=0.69. [V0047] (Adebayo et al., 2026) experiments on CellLife and achieves AUROC=0.76. A fifth document, [V0048], is the strongest match by metric (F1=0.83). Documents mentioning contrastive learning for agricultural yield only in prior-work sections (e.g., [V0015], [V0066], [V0158], [V0217]) are excluded as they do not constitute direct applications. Non-agricultural or non-contrastive documents are also excluded.
